New decision "Interpreted §10.1's 'verified via the SHARED helper'" relates to:
- 01KJQMC1WPEM30XZHNAMH9FCYT: "Separate vitest config and npm script for transcript evals with manifest-based fixture discovery"
- 01KJQQ43WFFJDCGJ8WHK0X6V0Z: "Transcript eval uses 0.6 threshold (vs 0.8 for synthetic) with aggregate average assertions instead of per-scorer"
- 01KJR024P2PW05VGNBYMB6KHDX: "Category-aware scorer filtering eliminates false positives instead of modifying plugin skills"
- 01KJR02B54GDWZQSH2EQJEH23C: "Regression baseline captures full eval state as JSON for CI comparison"
- 01KJRD6GYQS9389FYNG6804Z82: "Use current live session as third eval fixture — captures post-instruction-fix behavior for A/B comparison"
- 01KM6AYNPW2HNY7B4RAY67V3NX: "Coordination effectiveness test suite using real stores with temp dirs, no mocking"
- 01KQ098JXJJ98T9851Q37PMYB1: "Coordination benchmark uses assertion-based tests (pagination appears in assembly, affected_files correct, >=3 actionable signals) rather than numeric scoring (50 pts verify vs 20 pts redundant re-fix)"
- 01KQ098ZB0E70K71QJVA3NWQ55: "Bug-investigation benchmark uses assertion-based tests rather than numeric scoring"
- 01KQW7AZB771D3WQHPRH98VE29: "Rewrote server-startup test discrimination from signal/exit-code to stderr content. Empirical observation: with EOF stdin, both gate-firing and gate-not-firing exit with code 0 (no signal), but only the gate-not-firing path produces [twining] stderr output (dashboard startup, config warnings). The signal-based test was attempting to keep stdin open with a Readable.pipe to force SIGTERM on timeout, but Linux closes the pipe early when the source Readable enters end state. Stderr-content discrimination is platform-independent and 10x faster (343ms vs 3155ms). Rejected: increasing test timeout (doesn't fix root cause), holding stdin open differently with raw fd manipulation (fragile, more code)."
